decoded.equality: the 2,683-byte body parses to an object IDENTICAL, key for key and value for value, to the JSON document the MCP tool get_cross_chain_report_quote returned 0.7 seconds earlier (p-20261020-harbor-quote-tool-keyless-unpaid): same ten keys, same six rails, same amounts, same recipient, same confirmation count

decoded.method-note: the submission path is a POST of a receipt and signature, which the prober did not send; this record measures only what the endpoint says to a reader

finding: The api surface the entry names answers a keyless GET with the price document, not with a payment challenge, and that document is byte-equivalent in content to what the MCP quote tool serves: two surfaces, one price list. For a reader of the registry this settles that the quote is free to read on both the REST and the MCP path, and that nothing in either path is machine-payable.
